name: @negentropy/dsh-browser-flow
description: Observe and operate the user's already-open, already-authenticated DeepSeek Harness Desktop Sidebar Browser page

scripts.build: node scripts/build-host.mjs && node scripts/build-client.mjs && node scripts/build-graph.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/build-client.mjs && node scripts/build-graph.mjs --test-helper && node --import tsx/esm --test "tests/*.test.js"
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/build-client.mjs && node scripts/build-graph.mjs --test-helper && node --import tsx/esm --test --experimental-test-coverage "tests/*.test.js"
scripts.verify: npm run build && node scripts/build-graph.mjs --test-helper && go -C native/graph-core test ./... && npm run typecheck && node --import tsx/esm --test "tests/*.test.js"
